exposure: maternal clinical features (e.g., mean arterial pressure - MAP)
fetal ultrasound indicators (e.g., uterine artery resistance index)
cohort: The study included 80 pregnant women with preeclampsia and 160 healthy pregnant women controls enrolled from a hospital in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, China, between 2021 and 2022.
finding: PLGF concentrations in early and mid-pregnancy, combined with mean arterial pressure (MAP), were identified as independent factors for the onset of preeclampsia, leading to the establishment of a predictive model.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken at various stages of pregnancy: early pregnancy, mid-pregnancy, and late pregnancy, with specific uterine artery resistance index measurements at 20-24 weeks.
gest_age: Measurements were taken across early, mid-, and late pregnancy, including specific measurements at 20-24 weeks.
